description: Cases 1 and 3 of wf-orchestration-v1 (§5.2, §5.3): one instance per conversation of IO.api.sales@worker1, the IO node at whose exit the WF sits. Every conversation enters through AI.sales, which the WF asks with a menu: answer, invoice or consult. Invoice hands the conversation to AI.invoice, which holds it until it hands it back (its reply goes to the person, and sales takes the person's next message) or 3 minutes pass without a message. Consult tells the person that sales will check (when sales' reply is not empty), and writes sales' question to the supervisors' IO.slack.supervisores@motherbee. Each supervisor's message in the thread of that post goes to sales, which says whether it decides the question (decided, which goes to the person) or not yet (wait, and the WF waits on); when no decision comes in 30 minutes the WF tells sales so. A supervisor's message while sales answers the person, or while invoicing or payments hold the conversation, is logged and dropped (the default). A person's message costs two agent calls at most, and no agent is asked twice with the same message. An invoice issued with a due_in sets the timer payment_due at it; when it fires, the WF writes to AI.payments, whose answer goes to the person, and control goes back to sales with nothing pending. An agent's error, or an answer that does not come in 120 s, is noted in last_error and control goes back to sales; the person gets no answer to that message, and a pending payment_due stays. The catch takes none from the agent the WF waits for (waiting_for): its reply goes to the person, its reason goes to last_error, and sales holds the conversation; it notes in last_error an error no state takes, such as the cap on agent calls. After 3 minutes without messages and no invoice pending, the instance closes. The agents' answers go to the person as they came, through the IO node.

states.name: start
states.description: Keeps the person's message (customer) and their context.io, and moves on to sales.

states.name: sales_thinking
states.description: Sales holds the conversation: the person's message (customer) goes to AI.sales with its menu. Answer goes to the person; invoice hands the conversation to invoice, with the order kept in state; consult tells the person that sales will check, and writes sales' question to the supervisors. Entered only from a person's message. A message from the person meanwhile goes to sales too; a payment_due meanwhile is noted, and acted on in the next listening state. An error or no answer in 120 s goes back to listening, noted in last_error; none goes to the catch.

states.name: consulting
states.description: Sales' question is with the supervisors, at IO.slack.supervisores@motherbee, and the person was told that sales will check. A supervisor's message in the thread of that post goes to sales with vars.question, and sales says whether it decides the question. When none comes in 30 minutes, the WF tells sales so, and sales tells the person. A message from the person meanwhile goes to sales with the same menu, and sales' answer goes to the person; a payment_due meanwhile is noted.

options.description: The message decides nothing yet, such as a question among supervisors: your reply is empty.

states.name: sales_relaying
states.description: Sales has a supervisor's message, or the news that no decision came, and tells the person: its answer or its decided goes to the person, with the person's context.io, and sales holds the conversation; its wait goes back to consulting, and the WF waits for the decision. A message from the person meanwhile goes to sales, to answer it; a payment_due meanwhile is noted. An error or no answer in 120 s goes back to listening, noted in last_error; none goes to the catch.

options.name: answer
options.description: You tell the person.

states.name: sales_listening
states.description: Waits for the person, with sales in control: their next message is kept and goes to sales. A payment_due noted meanwhile, or firing now, goes to payments. A later answer of an agent (to a message the person sent while it was answering) goes to the person, but not a wait, and a supervisor's message that came after its wait goes to sales, which says whether it decides the question. After 3 minutes without messages, sales closes the instance, when no invoice is pending.

states.name: invoice_thinking
states.description: Invoice holds the conversation: the person's message (customer) goes to AI.invoice with vars.order and its menu. An invoice issued goes to the person and, with a due_in in minutes, hours or days (such as 2m, 1h or 30d), sets the timer payment_due at it; without one, last_error says so and no payment check follows. Handback gives the conversation back: its reply goes to the person, and sales takes the person's next message. Any other answer goes to the person. A message from the person meanwhile goes to invoice too; a payment_due meanwhile is noted. An error or no answer in 120 s gives control back to sales, noted in last_error; none goes to the catch.

states.name: payments_thinking
states.description: The invoice fell due: the WF writes to AI.payments, with vars.invoice, the person's context.io and its menu, and the agent decides what to tell the customer. Its answer, whatever its option, goes to the person, and control goes back to sales with nothing pending. A message from the person meanwhile goes to payments too. An error or no answer in 120 s also ends the payment check, noted in last_error.

states.name: closed
states.description: The conversation went 3 minutes without messages, with no invoice pending. A new message from the person starts a new instance, at sales.

states.description: The engine's own failures: an action that failed, such as a payment_due whose time SY.timer would not take. No transition of this definition goes here.
